title: Checkout
demoNotice: Demo store: payments are simulated and no money is taken.

destination.title: Where to?
destination.intro: Country, city and postal code are enough to show the delivery options and prices. A street address is needed only for delivery, not for pickup from the studio.
destination.postalHint: Optional in Israel. Required abroad, unless the destination has no postal codes.

errors.postalRequired: Enter a postal code. It is needed for delivery to this destination.

delivery.stepTitle: {count, plural, one {How would you like to receive it?} other {How would you like to receive them?}}
delivery.worksPrice: {count, plural, one {Price of the work} other {Price of the # works}}
delivery.unavailable: The delivery option you chose is not available for this destination. Please choose another one.
delivery.packingStretchedNote: The painting is sent as it is, stretched on its wooden frame.
delivery.packingRolledNote: The canvas is taken off its stretcher and sent rolled in a tube: shipping costs far less, and large paintings can go by Israel Post. On arrival it needs re-stretching on a frame (a framer can do it), at the buyer's cost.

notices.DAP_DUTIES: Import duties, taxes and clearance fees at the destination, if any, are paid by you on delivery (DAP).
notices.EU_LOW_VALUE_DUTY: From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2028 the EU charges a flat EUR 3 customs duty on low-value parcels.
notices.US_DUTY_FREE_CLEARANCE_FEES: Original paintings (HS 9701.91) enter the US duty free; the carrier may still charge clearance fees.
notices.US_FORMAL_ENTRY: Above USD 2,500 you are the importer of record (formal entry, CBP Form 5106).
notices.TRANSIT_ESTIMATE: Transit times are estimates and may change at customs.
